West Coast Financial Has Cut Its Holding in Apple (AAPL) as Stock Value Declined; Newfield Expl Co (NFX) Holder Acadian Asset Management Has Trimmed Its Position 
April 13, 2018 - By Peter Erickson 
Acadian Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Newfield Expl Co (NFX) by 12.36% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Acadian Asset Management Llc sold 9,730 shares as the company’s stock declined 24.76% with the market. The institutional investor held 68,973 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.17 million, down from 78,703 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Acadian Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Newfield Expl Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $5.14 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.29% or $0.61 during the last trading session, reaching $26.01. About 6.01 million shares traded or 48.42% up from the average. Newfield Exploration Company (NYSE:NFX) has declined 31.29%   downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.84% the S&P500. 
West Coast Financial Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 20.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 68,366 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.57M, down from 86,482 at the end of the previous reported quarter. West Coast Financial Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $887.75B market cap company. The stock increased 0.47% or $0.82 during the last trading session, reaching $174.96. About 646,921 shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Since December 7, 2017, it had 0 insider buys, and 4 sales for $19.89 million activity. SCHILLER PHILIP W had sold 69,491 shares worth $11.56M.

AAPL’s profit will be $13.75B for 16.14 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality.
